riskiest_assumption_test.assumption: Aspirants who have just applied to a matched exam will pay INR 49 (season) or INR 199 (year) for lifecycle tracking + a pre-submit check + reliable WhatsApp delivery, instead of relying on free Telegram/YouTube/board SMS.

experiment.type: Concierge WTP test with real UPI payment (behavioral), WhatsApp-only, no app
experiment.description: Pick central exams + ONE Hindi-belt state with application windows open in the next 3 weeks. Days 1-3: Hindi web eligibility checker (DOB, category, qualification, domicile) built on hand-curated, LLM-assisted rules for 10-20 live notifications; log curation minutes per notification. Users opt in on WhatsApp Business. Free: matched alerts with the complete what-you-need card; reminder repeats every 2-3 days until they reply APPLIED or NO. On APPLIED: offer 'Pakka Pro' — Season pass INR 49 (lifecycle tracking for this application + one pre-submit check of their preview/registration + WhatsApp/SMS fallback) and Year INR 199 — via a real UPI/Razorpay link with refund promise; deliver manually. Traffic: 20-30 state aspirant Telegram/WhatsApp groups (with admin permission) + 2 paid channel posts (INR 500-2,000 each) + <= INR 3,000 Meta ads in Hindi.
experiment.pass_threshold: All must hold within 14 days: (1) >= 300 completed eligibility profiles; (2) >= 100 users reply APPLIED to at least one match; (3) >= 8% of APPLIED users pay AND >= 10 total payments; (4) >= 50% of opted-in users have not blocked/STOPped by day 14 (persistent reminders tolerated); (5) median curation <= 30 min per notification with zero wrong eligibility verdicts in a 20-notification self-audit against the official PDFs.

riskiest_assumption_test.kill_criteria: Any of: < 3% of APPLIED users pay or < 5 payments; > 30% STOP/block rate; median curation > 60 min per notification or any wrong 'eligible' verdict found in audit. Then drop the subscription idea; if pre-submit checks alone sold, fall back to Form Pakka's per-check model.

all_assumptions_ranked.assumption: Applied users pay INR 49-199 for Pro (lifecycle + check + fallback)
A solo dev can keep structured eligibility rules (age-on-cutoff, relaxations, domicile, corrigenda) accurate for central + one state at <= 30 min/notification
Persistent until-applied reminders are welcomed, not muted/uninstalled
No-audience founder can acquire aspirants at <= INR 5/install via Telegram seeding + Hindi ASO
Lifecycle tracking materially raises retention (opens >= 3/month for applied users)
